title: bug: sh and ps1 wrappers record different ref forms for branch landings
description: record_commit for a committed completion/checkpoint gets ref=<branch> from moe-agent.sh (LAND_BRANCH, e.g. moe/work-2026-10-29) but ref=refs/heads/<branch> from moe-agent.ps1 (Invoke-MoeLanding, 3 call sites). The daemon stores it as reported, so task.commits / landing metadata differ by wrapper. Repro: postflight-owner-guard.cjs sequential case on ps1 (ledger completion row ref). Pick one form for both wrappers and add a parity assertion.
definitionOfDone: Both wrappers send the same ref form for branch landings (completion and checkpoint, including the post-CAS resend paths)
A postflight harness case asserts the exact ref on both sh and ps1
